reconciliation.conclusion: Both providers report negative funding and more short than long liquidations, but OI differs by $385M and reported funding magnitudes differ by about 19.5x. Snapshot times, venue coverage, contract universe, weighting and USD conversion are not harmonized. Preserve each series; do not average or infer a directional signal.

hypotheses.near_term_deleveraging: Plausible: Liqwall reports OI down 2.3%, negative funding and short liquidations exceeding long liquidations. Counterevidence: account-level long skew is high; provider coverage is not harmonized.
hypotheses.spot_supply_pressure: Plausible but unproven: Kraken last is 1.57% below 24h VWAP and 10.6% above the 24h low; top ask size is 3.35x top bid at one level. Counterevidence: only one venue and one level; Binance perpetual depth is nearly balanced at ±1%; no synchronized spot trade-flow evidence.
hypotheses.resting_bid_support: Possible but unproven: Binance perpetual book shows 51% bid share within ±1% and slightly more bids within ±2%. Counterevidence: asks are larger inside ±0.5%; displayed liquidity can disappear; this is not spot.
hypotheses.institutional_etf_demand: Unresolved: tracker flows disagree because fund universes, row vintages and definitions differ; the latest XRP Insights aggregate is positive over two days while other sources show partial or provisional outflows.
hypotheses.macro_beta_headwind: Plausible broad context: strong USD and hawkish Fed pricing. Counterevidence: no estimated XRP-specific beta or causal impact.

prediction.reason: The current observations remain asynchronous; Kraken has no event timestamp; OKX is quoted in USDT and its USD conversion leg is 22m06s stale; full spot L2 is missing; derivatives and ETF providers use different universes and vintages; raw-to-feature and walk-forward admission requirements remain unsatisfied.
